text:
sourav: Heads-up — I'm drafting the region-aware routing + model-variant fallback policy that will be used for multi-region hosted API. want quick takes on quotas, telemetry, and console UX.

maya: high level — prefer latency-first for interactive customers, cost-first for low-tier async. then map to model variants as fallback.

kevin: q: do we honor customer pin (region) strictly or treat as a soft preference?

liz: soft by default. if pinned and tier=enterprise -> honor with circuit-breaker warnings. otherwise prefer best latency.

maya: also need explicit per-region quota enforcement. can't have global quota silently overflowing a region. per-region and global quotas should both exist.

kevin: probing cadence? probes add traffic and change p95. thinking 1 probe / 10s per region per service.

infra-bot: probe-config suggestion:
```
{
  "probe_interval_s": 10,
  "window_s": 60,
  "sample_count": 6,
  "latency_metric": "p95",
  "failure_threshold": 0.02
}
```

maya: sounds fine. use exponential backoff on probes when region marked degraded.

sourav: model fallback behavior: primary model (large float32) -> fallback tier (int8 quant) -> lowest-cost small model. Should be per-route and per-customer-tier configurable.

kevin: how do we surface that in Console? need clarity: "Serving region", "Active model variant", "Fallback reason" in logs + dashboard.

liz: Console wire: show real-time region selected, probe-latency sparkline, active model id, and a reason badge (latency|capacity|quota). clickable drilldown to traces.

ops: alerting rules to watch: region_p95 > target, fallback_rate > 1%, token_cost_spike, dropped_requests_by_region.

maya: rollout UX: default policy = latency-first for pro+; opt-out toggle per-customer to pin region/model. provide canary policy button: "Canary in eu-west-1 (10%)" with automatic rollback if fallback_rate > 2% or p95 increases  > 30%.

kevin: internal API surface: route_decision = decideRoute({customer_tier, pinned_region, client_geo, probe_scores, quota_state, model_variants}). We should keep it pure and testable.

sourav: agree. arrange unit tests + sim harness. want to model 1M qps traffic split across regions in sim to catch oscillations.

infra-bot: sample route policy snippet for review:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  priority: [customer_tier, latency, cost]
  tiers:
    - name: enterprise
      prefer_pinned: true
      fallbacks:
        - model_variant: xl-fp32
          max_latency_ms: 250
        - model_variant: xl-int8
          max_latency_ms: 400
        - model_variant: l-small
          max_latency_ms: 1000
  probe:
    interval_s: 10
    p95_window_s: 60
  quotas:
    global: 1e9 # tokens/day
    per_region: true
```

liz: one sticky point — quota enforcement timing. if global is exhausted but region has headroom, do we allow tokens? i'm leaning no for rate-limited plans but yes for enterprise if contract allows.

maya: tie quota decisions to billing-tier rules in policy. simple rule: if plan.rate_limit_scope == 'global' -> enforce global first; if 'region' -> enforce per-region; enterprise can set override: true.

kevin: telemetry: expose these metrics per-customer, per-region, per-model-variant: request_count, success_rate, p50/95/99, fallback_count, avg_cost_per_token. keep retention 90d for enterprise, 14d for free.

ops: add a composite metric 'effective_latency' that includes probe + served p95 to catch probe-induced routing flips.

sourav: action items: 1) infra team to prototype probe engine + sim harness (kevin, infra). 2) eng-platform to spec route_decision API + unit tests (sourav, maya). 3) console team to mock UX panels (liz). 4) ops to draft alerts and SLO thresholds (ops).

deploy-bot: canary created: routing-policy/v2 -> eu-west-1 (10%) at 2024-06-05T14:21:20Z

kevin: quick note — add hysteresis and anti-flapping: min_stable_count=3 probes before switch, cool_down=30s after a switch.

maya: + add audit log entries for every automatic fallback decision (customer_id, reason, before_variant, after_variant).

sourav: perfect. i'll put a PR with the policy schema + tests by EOD. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

liz: thanks — will start mockups and link in the PR. :sparkles:

ops: will draft alerts and run a small chaos test once canary is up.

infra-bot: note: scheduled simulation job queued -> sim-run-20240605-01

sourav: closing the thread for now. follow-ups in the PR.
